name: taskly-lite-nextjs-design-d
description: Design D starter: an agent-first Next.js repo organized around an explicit, typed dependency graph (core -> features -> composition -> app).

notes.no-network-installs: This starter is scaffolded and verified WITHOUT running `npm install`. `dev`/`build`/`start` need the real Next.js toolchain and are not exercised here. `build:offline`, `test`, `lint:boundaries`, `manifest:generate/check`, and `ci` use only the standard toolchain (tsc + node stdlib) and are fully offline-runnable. See README.md.
